capabilities: Sync vault via desktop Git or GitHub API
Publish notes to GitHub Pages or EdgeOne
Manage daily notes, recurring tasks and reminders
Chat with notes through configured AI providers
Organize attachment names, folders and unused files
disambiguation: Not a single-purpose plugin; it is a suite whose sync, sharing, schedule, AI and editing parts are enabled individually.
extras: Settings interface is primarily in Chinese. Requires Obsidian 1.7.2 or later; AI, translation and sharing authorization need 1.11.4 or later. Published content is public and withdrawing a note does not erase Git history or caches. Automatic attachment cleanup is off by default. No telemetry.
problem: Obsidian users otherwise need several separate plugins and manual setup for syncing, publishing, scheduling, AI chat and everyday editing and attachment cleanup.

requires.name: Git and GitHub CLI for native Git sync
GitHub repository and token for GitHub API sync or publishing
Configured AI provider account for AI chat and translation
EdgeOne project for optional sharing link

summary: Configurable Obsidian toolkit that bundles Git or GitHub API sync, web publishing, daily notes and reminders, AI chat, editing, attachment and display tools.
